source_text: Globally, advocacy for voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) as an HIV prevention strategy persisted through 2025, with UNAIDS reporting that 35 million procedures conducted from 2008 to 2022 in 15 high-prevalence African countries averted an estimated 670,000 infections, despite faltering program scale-up and funding challenges. [91]
